set.body: Read-only follow-up from normalization-budget repair bd-01M478XB9V86YE7SR8BGH457ND. Hrfs.lwu in HrfFunctions.scala around487 computes ceil(span/0.005).toInt+1 before Height/Area calibration; Hrfs.daguerre around682 computes ceil(span/0.1).toInt+1 before unconditional peak calibration. These producers run during base construction before HrfSpec.genEither normalization admission. Add documented count and known-family work bounds before conversion/evaluation, preserve existing grids/normalization for admitted work and typed HrfSpec refusal before unsafe constructors. Keep public legacy facades compatible. Include huge finite spans, overflow, exact boundaries, basis-column work, JVM+JS parity tests and safe mutation evidence. This finding is source inspection; no enormous calibration loop was executed.
